task.title: Port the league model and format detection
task.description:
## Why
Every later stage reads the league model: teams, rosters, who holds which pick, standings and the league's format.

## Steps
1. Port `rebuild/league.py` to `web/src/engine/`: format detection (`fmt_of`, `fmt_key`, `same_family`, `strict_match`) and the `League` model.
2. Change the model to take already-fetched data as input instead of calling Sleeper itself.
3. Port team lookup (`find_team`), which matches a team name, manager name, username or roster id.
4. Port `position` from `rebuild/sleeper.py`.

## Done when
- The league-model parity test passes for every fixture.
